# Reference envelope fixtures

Copied from fb2cng's `convert/kfx/envelope/testdata` (GPL-3.0). These fixtures
were generated by an independent Python implementation using KFXInput's Ion
writer and Python's standard-library LZMA encoder. They contain synthetic
Unicode and binary bytes, not a copyrighted book.

The decoded plaintext fixture is `CONT\x00reference\xff\x80`. The LZMA fixtures
prepend 210 (`lzma.hex`) or 3,000 (`lzma64.hex`) repetitions of the UTF-8 string
`Привет, 世界!\x00`. They cross 4-KiB and 64-KiB page boundaries respectively.

The thumbnail integration tests construct their own synthetic book and use a
test-only envelope writer; they do not depend on optional private book fixtures.
